title: Data Operations Analyst
description: About Us:YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world's top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.What It's Like to Work at YipitData:YipitData isn't a place for coasting—it's a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you'll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:Ownership That Matters: You'll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomesRapid Growth: We compress years of learning into monthsMerit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenureVelocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intentionIf your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you've been waiting for.About The Role:The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs.Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will:Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics.Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs.Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time.Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale.Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows.Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available.Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy.Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances.Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have...1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality.Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments.Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on.The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data.High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis.Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability.Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders.Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation.Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required):Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms.Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows.Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus.What We Offer:Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunitiesWe care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.Personal laptopHealth and wellness packageCandidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. title: Technical Product Owner
description: ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage. WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams. Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment. Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process. WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued. OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

Develop reusable solution frameworks, accelerators, and capability mappings. Ensure alignment between customer-specific requirements and scalable product functionality. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Execution Partner with Sales and Delivery teams to support deal closures and ensure solution readiness. Coordinate across architecture, engineering, and implementation teams to ensure solution feasibility and implementation success. Prior experience working with global product organizations or system integrators supporting utilities. Strong understanding of digital transformation across utility domains (CIS, CX, Grid, DER, eMobility, or Field Operations). Working knowledge of programming languages such as Java, Python, or C#. Experience with web and mobile platforms and modern digital architecture frameworks.

You will be the first line of defense in securing our customers and upholding the integrity of their digital presence. This position is ideal for candidates who are early to mid in their cybersecurity career with 1-2 years of exp and are passionate about threat detection, user support, and protecting brands from malicious online activity. Key Responsibilities: 1. Technical Product Support (CloudSEK Product) – L1 Serve as the first point of contact for customer issues via email, chat, or phone. Troubleshoot and resolve basic technical issues using documentation and internal tools. Record and track support issues in our ticketing system with clarity and precision. Collaborate with engineering and security teams to escalate unresolved issues. Contribute to user guides and help documentation for common support queries. Continuously learn and apply knowledge of cybersecurity and threat detection. 2. Brand Protection & Takedown Analyst Monitor, identify, and document phishing websites, fake domains, and impersonation profiles on social media platforms. Initiate and manage takedown requests across hosting providers, registrars, and platforms. Provide timely follow-ups and status updates to internal teams and stakeholders. Assist in building and maintaining playbooks, SOPs, and threat feeds relevant to brand abuse. Work closely with the intelligence team to map phishing campaigns and related threat infrastructure. 3. L1 Security Analyst (SOC/Threat Monitoring) As a member of the comanaged services team, monitor alerts and incidents generated on the CloudSEK portal. Conduct initial triage and classification of potential threats. Document response steps and escalate incidents as per defined protocols. Stay updated with the latest cyber threats, TTPs, and security advisories. Apply AI prompt engineering techniques to improve efficiency in threat detection and knowledge handling. Desired Qualifications & Skills: Bachelor's degree in Technology, Cybersecurity, or related fields. Prior exposure or a strong interest in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, or SOC operations. Understanding of phishing campaigns, social engineering tactics, and brand impersonation threats. Strong communication skills (written & verbal). Ability to work independently in a rotational shift environment supporting global customers. Experience with support ticketing tools (e.G., Freshdesk, Zendesk, Jira Service Desk). title: Senior Studio Specialist
description: JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of science video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company. The Role As a Senior Studio Specialist at JoVE, you will drive the operational excellence of our in-house creative studio. You will execute and oversee project execution, optimize workflows, and introduce AI-powered solutions to enhance efficiency, quality, and scalability. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who understands the full creative production lifecycle and thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment - a love for science is a plus! Responsibilities: Oversee and coordinate the execution of creative projects from brief to final delivery Maintain the studio production schedule and assign projects to the in-house motion graphics team based on availability, timelines, and project scope. Track the day-to-day progress of projects in the pipeline, follow up on deadlines, flag delays, and ensure workload distribution supports on-time delivery. Define and track KPIs, deadlines, and performance metrics to ensure smooth production cycles Work closely with the Director of Marketing to translate business objectives into actionable creative plans Collaborate with internal stakeholders to refine briefs and propose effective design solutions Create and edit high-quality video assets to support marketing campaigns, product launches, digital initiatives, and brand awareness efforts. Design, document, and continuously improve studio workflows and cross-functional processes Ensure brand consistency and creative quality standards across all deliverables Identify bottlenecks and implement scalable improvements to increase efficiency Lead the integration of AI technologies into creative workflows, including automation, asset generation, project tracking, and quality optimization Requirements: 5–7 years of experience in creative production, studio coordination, or motion graphics environments Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent creative projects while ensuring quality and on-time delivery Strong experience supporting and improving production workflows within creative teams Demonstrated ability to coordinate designers and balance workloads effectively in a fast-paced environment Proficiency with project management tools such as Asana (or similar platforms) Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools to improve production efficiency and creative output Strong attention to detail and quality control across all stages of the creative process Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders Solid understanding of the end-to-end creative production lifecycle (briefing, design, review, revisions, final delivery) Why Join JoVE? You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education. Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration. Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Gerente De Testes

Esta posição é responsável pela supervisão de testes de ponta a ponta, incluindo execução da estratégia, gerenciamento de recursos, coordenação com as partes interessadas, gerenciamento de riscos e relatórios de progresso. O Gerente de Testes planeja, controla e aprimora continuamente as atividades de teste para garantir que o software e os sistemas integrados atendam aos padrões de qualidade definidos antes do lançamento. Isso inclui definir objetivos de qualidade, apoiar a automação de testes quando apropriado e garantir que as equipes compreendam claramente os processos de teste, controles e expectativas de governança. Principais Responsabilidades - Definir, comunicar e garantir o cumprimento da estratégia geral de testes junto a todas as partes interessadas e equipes de entrega.
- Identificar, garantir e coordenar os recursos de teste alinhados ao escopo e aos marcos de entrega.
- Garantir que os ambientes de teste, os dados e as integrações de sistema estejam disponíveis e adequados à finalidade.
- Analisar e gerenciar defeitos, riscos e problemas decorrentes de todas as fases de teste. Estabelecer e manter um repositório centralizado de cenários e ativos de teste.
- Identificar e reutilizar materiais de teste existentes para melhorar a eficiência e a consistência.
- Definir e finalizar o escopo de testes em conjunto com todas as áreas impactadas.
- Definir, preparar e validar os requisitos de dados de teste de acordo com o escopo acordado.
- Desenvolver planos detalhados de execução de testes diários, incluindo cenários de contingência e de menor prioridade.
- Definir e obter consenso sobre critérios claros de conclusão dos ciclos de teste.
- Identificar e gerenciar o escopo de testes de regressão para proteger a funcionalidade existente. Requisitos Profissional Senior, com experiência comprovada liderando iniciativas complexas de testes em sistemas de grande escala.
- Ampla experiência prática em testes de software e garantia de qualidade em ambientes corporativos.
- Capacidade comprovada de liderar, coordenar e motivar equipes de teste em múltiplos fluxos de trabalho.
- Sólida experiência em planejamento, escopo, estimativa e análise de testes.
- Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração com stakeholders em equipes de negócios e técnicas.
- Mentalidade analítica com forte capacidade de resolução de problemas e atenção aos detalhes.
- Experiência comprovada na definição, implementação e gestão de estratégias e planos de teste.
- Sólido conhecimento de modelos SDLC e uma ampla gama de metodologias de teste.
- Conhecimento prático de ferramentas, frameworks e melhores práticas de automação de testes. Experiência Desejáveis - Familiaridade com as plataformas SAP S/4HANA e Salesforce Lightning, incluindo módulos, aplicações e abordagens de entrega.
- Formação técnica com compreensão de integrações de sistemas e protocolos de interface.
- Experiência em planejamento e execução de testes de desempenho, carga e estresse.
- Forte experiência com modelos de entrega ágil e colaboração em equipes multifuncionais.
- Capacidade de análise de negócios, incluindo técnicas de levantamento e validação de requisitos.
- Experiência comprovada em TDD (Desenvolvimento Orientado a Testes).
- Experiência comprovada com Jira XRay, Selenium e Tricentis TTA

Como será seu dia-a-dia? Projetar e revisar arquiteturas seguras para aplicações web, APIs e sites, identificando vulnerabilidades e propondo melhorias estruturais. Configurar, evoluir e automatizar pipelines CI/CD no GitLab com integração de ferramentas de segurança (SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning), garantindo que segurança faça parte do fluxo de entrega. Apoiar times de desenvolvimento na adoção de práticas de desenvolvimento seguro (Secure SDLC), conduzindo análises de código e orientações sobre boas práticas de segurança. Criar automações para monitoramento, detecção de ameaças, resposta a incidentes e hardening de ambientes, reduzindo a superfície de ataque de forma contínua. Atuar na segurança de infraestruturas multicloud (AWS, Azure e/ou GCP), incluindo IAM, gestão de segredos, redes e conformidade com políticas de segurança. Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre o cenário de ameaças, CVEs relevantes e novas tecnologias de segurança, trazendo insights para o time. Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter: Experiência com threat modeling, revisão de arquitetura de apps e sites, e conhecimento de OWASP Top 10 e boas práticas de segurança em APIs REST/GraphQL. Domínio avançado de GitLab CI/CD, com experiência em configurar stages de segurança (SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets detection) e integrar ferramentas como Trivy, Semgrep ou similares. Conhecimento de práticas como code review com foco em segurança, análise de dependências vulneráveis, gestão de segredos e políticas de controle de acesso. Capacidade de desenvolver scripts, playbooks e automações (Python, Bash ou similares) para triagem de alertas, resposta a incidentes e hardening de ambientes. Experiência em ao menos um provedor (AWS, Azure ou GCP) com foco em IAM, segurança de redes, gestão de segredos (Vault, KMS) e conformidade (CIS Benchmarks, CSPM). Familiaridade com OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite, Snyk, SonarQube, Checkov, Prowler ou equivalentes. Você irá se destacar se: Conhecimento de frameworks como NIST, ISO 27001 ou SOC 2. title: Cloud Ai/Ml Engineer
description:
Looking for an experienced Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer to lead the automation of complex financial workflows at Prosigliere. Description We are seeking a Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer with a\ "cloud-first\" mindset to join our growing team. In this role, you won't just build models;
you will architect end-to-end intelligent systems that redefine how we handle financial data. You will be responsible for analyzing manual credit request processes and identifying opportunities to automate them using cutting-edge cloud AI services. The ideal candidate bridges the gap between raw data and actionable business intelligence, building tools that ingest high-stakes data from credit agencies, analyze it through sophisticated AI pipelines, and present it via human-in-the-loop dashboards. You will work closely with engineering leadership to turn manual bottlenecks into scalable, automated cloud solutions. Responsibilities Process Architecture: Analyze existing credit request workflows to identify automation opportunities using cloud-native AI/ML solutions. Intelligent Data Ingestion: Design and implement processes utilizing Document Intelligence (OCR/Form parsing), and Web Search integration to gather and structure fragmented data. Third-Party Data Synthesis: Build tools to ingest and analyze complex results from credit agencies (e.G., D&B, Experian, Equifax ) to drive automated decision-making. Custom Tooling: Develop custom software bridges to fill gaps between standard cloud AI services and specific business requirements. Human-in-the-Loop Systems: Create intuitive dashboards that visualize AI-driven analysis, allowing human reviewers to audit and approve automated recommendations. Cloud Deployment: Deploy and maintain robust MLOps pipelines in a cloud environment, ensuring high reliability and security for sensitive financial data. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Communicate technical AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate with backend teams to ensure seamless data flow. Technology Requirements 5+ years of experience in software engineering with a heavy focus on Cloud AI/ML implementations. Cloud-First Expertise: Proven experience with Vertex AI (GCP), Azure AI, or AWS SageMaker, specifically utilizing high-level AI services (Document AI, Search/Discovery, etc.). Data Integration: Proficiency in building API integrations and data pipelines that handle structured and unstructured data from external financial vendors. Python Mastery: Expert-level Python skills, including experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks for building agentic AI workflows. Visualization: Experience building data dashboards using tools like Streamlit, Looker, or custom React-based frontend components. Security Mindset: Deep understanding of handling sensitive PII (Personally Identifiable Information) within cloud environments. Profile Requirements Solution Architect Mentality: Ability to look at a manual business process and map it to a technical AI roadmap. Independent Problem Solver: A self-starter who can build\ "the bridge\" when a standardout-of-the-box tool doesn't exist. Strong Communication: Ability to explain why an AI made a specific recommendation to stakeholders. Agile Learner: A commitment to staying current with the rapid pace of LLM, RAG, and Agentic AI developments. AI Tooling: Proficiency with AI-first engineering approaches and tooling is a plus. If you are familiar with the Cognition platform with Windsurf and Devin, that is even better. Certifications: Google, Azure or AWS Cloud AI certifications are a big plus!

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview: We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications. Key Responsibilities: Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals. Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance. Domain Tracks: You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the followin g;
expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus. Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems. Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design. Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry. Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification. Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design. Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference. Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads. Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design. Nuclear / Energy — reactor core design, shielding, thermal-hydraulics, renewable energy system sizing, grid-scale storage design. Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration. Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration. Required Qualifications: Master’s or PhD in a relevant engineering/applied science field. 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience, producing validated designs from competing specs (not just analysis). Proficient in at least one open-source simulation tool relevant to the domain. Strong Python (or equivalent) scripting skills. High attention to detail across units, boundary conditions, convergence, and physical realism. Offer Details: Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type: Contractor Evaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements. After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. title: Staff Data Scientist
description: Cientista de Dados Sobre a Arvo Temos o propósito de tornar a saúde no Brasil mais acessível para todos. Nossa jornada começa com o uso de dados e inteligência artificial para reduzir fraudes, abusos e desperdícios em pagamentos de saúde. Acreditamos que a única maneira de alcançar isso é através de um time incrível, com pessoas apaixonadas por saúde e compradas na nossa missão de transformar o setor. Perfil desejado Buscamos uma pessoa cientista de dados com forte capacidade analítica, curiosidade e autonomia para explorar novos problemas e domínios. Alguém com perfil crítico e generalista, que se motive mais por entender e resolver problemas complexos com dados do que apenas por desenvolver modelos ou escrever código. Procuramos alguém que combine rigor técnico e pensamento científico, com uma barra de qualidade alta. Que seja capaz de propor hipóteses, testar soluções de forma estruturada e entregar resultados robustos, bem validados e sustentáveis. Responsabilidades Analisar dados complexos e extrair insights que gerem valor para o negócio e para os clientes Desenvolver relatórios, dashboards e visualizações de dados para comunicação de resultados Identificar tendências, padrões e anomalias nos dados para apoiar a tomada de decisão estratégica Trabalhar em conjunto com as equipes de engenharia de dados para garantir qualidade, integridade e acessibilidade dos dados Criar e documentar métricas de desempenho e indicadores-chave para monitoramento dos processos Apoiar na definição de requisitos e especificação de soluções baseadas em dados Realizar estudos de viabilidade e análise de impacto de soluções propostas Comunicar de forma clara e objetiva os achados analíticos para diferentes stakeholders Qualificações Mínimas Formação em Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística ou área correlata Conhecimento em Python Experiência com análise de dados e geração de insights acionáveis Experiência em manipulação e consulta de bancos de dados SQL e não relacionais Boa comunicação para interagir com diferentes stakeholders e traduzir requisitos de negócio em soluções analíticas Experiência com modelagem estatística ou machine learning. Qualificações Desejadas Experiência na área de healthtech Conhecimento em ferramentas de ETL Familiaridade com Google Cloud (GCP) e BigQuery Descrição da vaga Essa pessoa será responsável por analisar dados complexos da carteira de clientes, identificar padrões e oportunidades e traduzir insights em recomendações estratégicas. Trabalhará em parceria com os times de Business e Health, desenvolvendo relatórios e dashboards que apoiem a tomada de decisão. Também atuará junto à engenharia de dados para garantir a qualidade e acessibilidade das informações, além de definir métricas e indicadores para monitorar o desempenho das iniciativas. Benefícios Plano de Saúde Bradesco Saúde Nacional II (TNMI) VA/VR: R$1.080 no Flash Acesso ao wellhub (gympass) Vaga remota

title: Arquiteto De Software
description: A VMetrix é uma empresa SaaS que desenvolve uma plataforma financeira integral utilizada por bancos, fundos de pensão, gestoras de fundos, corretoras e asset managers no Chile e na América Latina. Nossa plataforma cobre o ciclo completo de gestão de investimentos: desde a captura de operações e gestão do ciclo de vida transacional, até a precificação, contabilidade, risco de mercado, compliance regulatório e reporting. Propósito do Cargo Arquiteto de Software é responsável por definir, evoluir e governar a arquitetura técnica da plataforma VMetrix. Este papel atua como ponte entre os requisitos de negócio financeiro, as restrições regulatórias e a implementação técnica, garantindo que as decisões arquiteturais suportem a escalabilidade, manutenibilidade e compliance da plataforma a longo prazo. Lidera o design dos sistemas mais complexos, estabelece os padrões técnicos para toda a equipe de desenvolvimento e governa a adoção estratégica de ferramentas de IA no ciclo de engenharia. Responsabilidades Principais: Desenvolvimento e Manutenção da Plataforma Desenvolver e manter módulos core da plataforma: ciclo de vida transacional (captura, validação, aprovação, liquidação), precificação de instrumentos, contabilidade de investimentos, risco de mercado e reporting regulatório. Implementar lógica de negócio financeiro complexa: processos de precificação mark-to-market, cálculos de P&L, accruals, amortizações, simulações end-of-day e processos batch de fechamento. Escrever código bem estruturado, eficiente, testável e aderente aos padrões arquiteturais definidos pela equipe de Arquitetura. Identificar bugs, gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria na base de código, propondo e implementando soluções com foco em qualidade e manutenibilidade. Antecipar necessidades futuras do sistema, sendo proativo na identificação de riscos técnicos e propondo soluções antes que se tornem impedimentos. Arquitetura de Dados e PL/SQL Projetar e otimizar procedures PL/SQL em Oracle 21c, incluindo pipelined functions, estratégias com Global Temporary Tables e packages de cálculo financeiro. Construir APIs REST robustas para integração com sistemas externos (ERPs, sistemas contábeis, provedores de dados de mercado), cobrindo múltiplas classes de ativos. Participar no design de motores genéricos com arquitetura metadata-driven, múltiplas estratégias de execução e cache de alto desempenho. Qualidade, Testes e Revisão de Código Analisar, depurar e testar software de forma sistemática, garantindo conformidade com as especificações técnicas definidas. Realizar revisões de código com foco em qualidade, segurança, performance e aderência aos padrões arquiteturais da plataforma. Definir e aplicar estratégias de testes (unitários, integração, contrato) em colaboração com o time de Arquitetura. Garantir que os módulos desenvolvidos sejam seguros, estáveis e aderentes às exigências regulatórias dos mercados atendidos. Colaboração Técnica e Mentoria Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com o Arquiteto de Software e Tech Leads para o cumprimento das diretrizes técnicas e das demandas da área. Realizar mentoria técnica de desenvolvedores juniores e plenos: revisões de design, pair programming e transferência de conhecimento do domínio financeiro. Participar ativamente de reuniões técnicas de equipe para discussão e alinhamento de demandas, soluções e prioridades. Monitorar tendências e tecnologias, contribuindo com propostas de melhoria de processos e ferramentas utilizadas no desenvolvimento dos produtos da empresa. Desenvolvimento Assistido por IA Utilizar ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) de forma produtiva e responsável no ciclo diário de desenvolvimento: geração de código, revisão, debugging e escrita de testes. Elaborar e consumir especificações técnicas otimizadas para uso com LLMs, garantindo que a documentação sirva tanto para a equipe quanto como contexto de alta qualidade para ferramentas de IA generativa. Aplicar engenharia de prompts no contexto de desenvolvimento: formular contextos precisos, decompor problemas e validar criticamente as saídas de modelos de linguagem. Requisitos Técnicos: Formação acadêmica: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou certificações técnicas relevantes são diferenciais. 5+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software. Domínio avançado de Java 8+ e Spring Boot 2.7+ (injeção de dependências, REST controllers, transações, testes). Experiência sólida em Oracle Database (PL/SQL, pipelined functions, partitioning, performance tuning, schemas complexos). Conhecimento prático de Kubernetes (OKE) e deployments em containers (Docker, WebLogic em OKE). Experiência com padrões de arquitetura: metadata-driven designs, cache distribuído (Caffeine/Redis), event-driven, repository pattern. Familiaridade com ferramentas de desenvolvimento modernas: Git e Git Flow, pipelines CI/CD, Postman/OpenAPI. Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA: Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot ou similares — incluindo uso em geração de código, escrita de testes, refatoração e debugging. Capacidade de engenharia de prompts aplicada ao desenvolvimento: saber formular contextos precisos, decompor problemas e validar criticamente as saídas de modelos de linguagem. Capacidade de ler e produzir especificações técnicas detalhadas em formato Markdown. Requisitos Desejáveis: Conhecimento do domínio financeiro: renda fixa, renda variável, derivativos, fundos de investimento, gestão de portfólios, contabilidade de investimentos, risco de mercado. Experiência com regulação financeira brasileira ou latino-americana (CVM, BACEN, ANBIMA, ou órgãos equivalentes). Experiência com integrações Office (Excel Add-ins) para plataformas SaaS financeiras. Familiaridade com padrões da indústria financeira (FpML, ISDA, ou outros). Experiência com observabilidade: Grafana, métricas de aplicação, alerting. Conhecimento de práticas GitOps e versionamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC). Familiaridade com testes de contrato (contract testing) e testes de integração em arquiteturas de microsserviços. Certificação Java (OCA/OCP) ou certificações equivalentes em tecnologias do stack. Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas de tecnologia, engenharia ou gestão de inovação. Processo de Candidatura: Candidatura: Candidate-se diretamente pelo LinkedIn. Teste técnico: Os candidatos selecionados receberão uma avaliação técnica online. Esta etapa é obrigatória e parte fundamental do processo. Entrevista com Líder e RH: Uma conversa com a equipe para te conhecer melhor e aprofundar sua experiência. Decisão: Informaremos o resultado com feedback, independentemente de você avançar ou não. Por que trabalhar na VMetrix Na VMetrix, não buscamos “fazer mais barulho”, mas sim construir confiança em um mercado onde as decisões importam. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma função estratégica, com autonomia real, impacto direto no negócio e visibilidade executiva. Você fará parte de uma empresa que está redefinindo como as instituições financeiras adotam tecnologia crítica, em um ambiente desafiador, sofisticado e de alto nível profissional. Se você se motiva a construir marca, reputação e relações de longo prazo no coração do sistema financeiro, a VMetrix é o lugar.

This role is pivotal in optimizing and managing our Salesforce ecosystem, driving business growth through effective CRM solutions. Proven expertise in integrating Salesforce with external applications using APIs, middleware, or integration platforms. Strong knowledge of AI-led automation tools within Salesforce, including Einstein Analytics and process automation capabilities. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively across teams. Experience with Agile methodologies and project management is a plus. title: Analista De Automação De Processos Pleno
description:
**You're here because something else has been letting you down.** A trainee program that doesn't actually grow you. A BigCo that promises fast growth and takes 5 years. A consulting firm where all you see is PowerPoint. A startup that's really just a BigCo with beer on Fridays. You want something else. Something you build yourself. We have that. --- ### Who we are Sofira is an AI-first legaltech. We create AI agents that automate repetitive corporate legal work. The legal industry in Brazil is broken. Large enterprises spend millions on legal claims every year. Our mission is to apply artificial intelligence to solve real pain points, bringing efficiency and scale to complex operations. --- ### The role: Founder's Associate You will work directly with the CEO to **build and automate processes, define strategy, and stand up new areas of the company from scratch** -- whatever is most important and most urgent in that week. In practice, this means your week-to-week looks wildly different: - One week you're 100% focused on fundraising: researching investors, building the deck, sharpening the strategy.
- The next week you're building an automation bot that sources candidates for our next hire.
- The next week you're standing up our commercial machine from zero: ICP, lead lists, cadences, CRM.
- Sometimes you're doing all three in the same week. The common thread: you figure out what matters most, execute, and ask for help when stuck -- you don't suffer in silence. --- ### Your first 30 days - **Week 1:** understand everything about Sofira -- product, customers, market, strategy, team. By the end of the week you can explain us in 60 seconds to a stranger.
- **Week 2:** map everything that can be automated. Surface the 5 highest-leverage automations we should build.
- **Week 3:** build the commercial machine from scratch -- ICP, lead sourcing, cadences, CRM, outbound sequences.
- **Week 4:** start generating your own demands. You see what needs to be built next and you propose it. By month 12, you've touched commercial, recruitment, fundraising, operations, and probably 1-2 things we haven't even planned for yet. --- ### What you get (beyond salary) **Absurdly fast learning.** You'll learn in 12 months what takes 5 years at a corporate. No exaggeration. **Proximity to senior founders.** You'll be in every meeting the CEO is. You'll see product decisions happen. You'll see investor pitches happen. You'll see enterprise contracts being negotiated in real time. **Premium AI tools on us.** ChatGPT Plus, Claude Max, Cursor, Gemini, Perplexity Pro -- whatever helps you move faster, paid by the company. --- ### Where this role can take you In 18-24 months, depending on how you perform, you'll have 3 open paths: - **Head of an area you built yourself** (most likely Growth, Operations, or Recruiting) -- you'll have natural seniority because you built the playbook - **Chief of Staff** -- you already know how every department works - **Your own company** -- with what you learn here, you'll be ready to start your own thing, if that's your dream. --- ### Who we're looking for You: - Are in your **last year of college** or **up to 2 years post-graduation**- Are in **Engineering (any), Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, Computer Science, or a similar analytical field**- Come from a **strong university** (Insper, ESPM, FGV, USP, Unicamp, ITA, PUC-RJ/SP, IBMEC, Mackenzie, Federal Universities, or equivalent)- **Built something real during college** -- inside an empresa junior, entrepreneurship league, AIESEC, a side project, a startup, or a student organization. We care less about the title on your resume and more about the output: something that existed because you made it exist. And also: - **You get shit done.** Give you a task with no time, no budget, and no idea how to do it -- you still deliver. You're the person people call when everything's on fire and someone needs to fix it. You squeeze blood from stones.
- **You hate doing by hand what could be automated.** You're allergic to inefficiency. When you catch yourself doing the same task twice, you start plotting how to kill the third time -- with AI, a script, a no-code tool, anything. Manual work that a robot could do makes you twitch.
- **You fall into rabbit holes.** When a topic grabs you, you disappear into it. You've spent an entire weekend learning why airplane windows have a tiny hole, how submarines stay underwater, or something equally random -- just because you couldn't let go. You're self-taught by default. Nobody has to tell you to go learn something.
- **You run multiple things in parallel -- and you like it that way.** Being locked onto one single focus for 6 months would bore you to death. You get energy from context-switching, not tired from it.
- **You want to be great. Yesterday.** Whether that means running your own company one day, being the best at what you do, or leading a team -- you're not willing to wait 5 years to see yourself there. You feel the urgency.
- **You're tech and AI first.** You didn't major in Computer Science, but you speak tech fluently. You prompt well. You read docs. You're comfortable with tools, APIs, and automations even if you don't build them from scratch. If something is possible with code or AI, you know it's possible -- and you'll figure out how. You've probably already turned down a "stable" and predictable offer because you know it's not for you. --- ### The honest deal We work a lot. This is not a 9-to-5 job. We're building something from zero on top of a R$140 billion market that hasn't seen real innovation in 20 years. That takes everything we have. In return we give: - **Competitive PJ salary.**- **Real ownership of what we build.** We dream big, and we want everyone who builds it alongside us to come along for the ride. You'll own a real piece of the company -- yours to earn as you grow with us. --- ### This is NOT for you if - You need someone to tell you exactly what to do every day - You prefer stable, predictable environments with well-defined processes - You want to be a specialist in one thing - You feel uncomfortable when you don't know something yet - You want an impressive title more than real impact - You don't tolerate working on multiple fronts at the same time - You expect promotions based on tenure If you read this far and felt uncomfortable with any of these points -- respect the discomfort. Don't apply. --- ### How to apply Apply and send me (Priscila Holanda) a DM answering this one question: **"Tell me about the time you most successfully hacked some (non-computer) system to your advantage."** Be specific. We want the actual story.

title: Controlling Supervisor
description:
Role DescriptionThis is a full-time, on-site role for a Controlling Supervisor located in Sorocaba, SP. The Controlling Supervisor will oversee financial planning, cost management, and budgeting processes to ensure operational efficiency. They will analyze financial performance, create detailed financial reports, and provide insights to support decision-making. The role includes collaboration with cross-functional teams, ensuring compliance with company policies, and identifying areas for cost optimization and process improvement. Conduct financial planning (annual and monthly budget vs. actual), in accordance with the parent company's calendar and guidelines, consolidating information from various areas and preparing financial analyses and statements to support senior management in decision-making;
Perform CAPEX analyses (budgeted vs. actual), monitoring deviations and opportunities for optimization;
Ensure the planning andcontrol of working capital, through the projection of revenues, costs, expenses, payroll, accounts receivable and payable, inventories and taxes, identifying financial needs and opportunities;
Prepare monthly resultsbudget and Balance Sheet, with critical analysis and consolidation of systemic data and data from other areas, supporting preventive and improvement actions;
Monitor the results of cyclical inventories, both internal and external, ensuring adequate financial impact;
Monitor and auditcompany materials held by suppliers, performing physical vs. system reconciliations and ensuring the accuracy of balances;
Perform monthly P&L closing, analyzing revenues, costs, operating expenses, freight, payroll, and extraordinary variations, in accordance with internal rules and procedures;
Update financial and operational databases (volumes, prices, average costs, risks, and opportunities), contributing to the predictability of monthly and annual results;
Prepare and report financial and management indicators to the plant and headquarters, through systems, reports, and executive presentations;
Prepare and update management presentations and strategic reports;
Attend to internal and external audits, providing information, analysis, and evidence;
Provide technicalsupport to area employees, guiding and clarifying doubts related to controllership processes;
Perform other related activities inherent to the position, as directed by the immediate supervisor.Assess the impacts of exchange rate variations, mapping exchange rate exposure based on imported items and performing scenario simulations;
- Prepare monthly results budget and Balance Sheet, with critical analysis and consolidation of systemic data and data from other areas, supporting preventive and improvement actions;
QualificationsEnglish -FluentSAP Experience Strong financial management skills, including budgeting, forecasting, and cost controlProficiency in financial analysis tools, reporting systems, and accounting softwareExcellent leadership, team coordination, and decision-making abilitiesAnalytical skills with attention to detail, critical thinking, and problem-solving capabilitiesUnderstanding of compliance standards, internal controls, and corporate regulationsEffective written and verbal communication skills in both Portuguese and EnglishAbility to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlinesBachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related fieldRelevant experience in controlling, financial management, or a similar leadership roleExperience in manufacturing or automotive industries is a strong advantage

title: Tech Lead Java
description:
Tech Lead JavaA jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a RethinkSomos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Diversidade e InclusãoPara repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência.Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel?Você atuará como principal referência técnica de TI para o time e para o cliente, sendo responsável por garantir a qualidade das entregas, a evolução técnica da equipe e um ambiente colaborativo alinhado à cultura. Além disso, terá um papel ativo na gestão das entregas, acompanhando o andamento das atividades, identificando riscos e garantindo que os compromissos assumidos sejam cumpridos com qualidade. Também contribuirá com decisões de arquitetura e direcionamento técnico, apoiando o time na construção de soluções robustas, escaláveis e alinhadas às boas práticas. Por fim, será responsável por desenvolver o time, atuando com mentoria, feedbacks técnicos e nivelamento de conhecimento.Como será seu dia a dia?Alinhar objetivos do time e assegurar a execução dos processos internos;
Acompanhar dinâmicas deequipes ágeis, facilitando a comunicação e desbloqueando obstáculos;
Apoiar o time de projetos na criação de cronogramas e estimativas;
Realizar entrevistas técnica para novos membros e definir perfis necessários junto à coordenação;
Assegurar que as ferramentas de trabalho (JIRA, documentação) estejam atualizadas;
Resolver conflitos e manter um ambiente colaborativo, positivo e focado em resultados.Para esta vaga, é essencial:Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento backend com Java, com atuação consistente em ambientes de produção e entendimento do ciclo completo de desenvolvimento (do desenho à sustentação);
Domínio de Spring Boot,incluindo construção de APIs, segurança, persistência de dados e organização de aplicações escaláveis e de fácil manutenção;
Conhecimento prático embancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL, com capacidade de modelagem, escrita de queries eficientes e entendimento de performance e uso adequado de cada tecnologia;
Vivência com AWS, compreendendo o uso de serviços como EC2, S3, RDS e Lambda no contexto de aplicações reais, incluindo deploy, configuração e monitoramento básico;
Experiência comcontainers (Docker e/ou Kubernetes), entendendo o ciclo de vida das aplicações e sua execução em ambientes containerizados;
Experiência na construção e integração de APIs RESTful, seguindo boas práticas de design, versionamento e segurança;
Familiaridade com controle de versão utilizando Git, incluindo colaboração em equipe, code review e organização de branches;
Experiência comtestes unitários, garantindo qualidade e confiabilidade do código entregue;
Vivência atuando como referência técnica ou liderança de times, apoiando decisões, direcionando soluções e contribuindo com a evolução técnica da equipe;
Capacidade analítica, autonomia, proatividade e segurança na tomada de decisão em cenários de pressão ou ambiguidade.Você pode se destacar se:Possuir experiência com práticas de DevOps e construção de pipelines de CI/CD;
Tiver vivência com desenvolvimento de arquiteturas resilientes e escaláveis;
Tiver conhecimento em ferramentas de busca e monitoramento, como ElasticSearch. Curtiu a oportunidade?Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Noc Infrastructure Engineer
description:
ITTConnect is seeking an NOC / Infrastructure Engineer to work remotely from anywhere in Brazil for a client in the US. MUST BE fluent in English. The Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for supporting and maintaining customer IT infrastructure within the Managed Services environment. This role focuses on resolving technical issues, supporting backend infrastructure systems, and collaborating with customer IT teams to deploy and maintain solutions. Infrastructure Engineers combine technical troubleshooting with proactive monitoring and documentation to ensure stable and secure client environments. Key Responsibilities Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to servers, virtualization, storage, and core infrastructure systems. Serve as an escalation point for the IT Support team on complex infrastructure-related incidents. Work directly with customers and their IT teams to support the deployment, configuration, and maintenance of infrastructure solutions. Investigate alerts and system reports to proactively identify potential infrastructure issues and performance risks. Follow established runbooks, procedures, and architectural documentation to resolve incidents. Exercise sound technical judgment when diagnosing and resolving infrastructure issues that may not have predefined solutions. Assist with the creation and maintenance of runbooks, diagrams, and infrastructure documentation. Participate in system maintenance activities such as upgrades, patching, and system health checks. Document incident resolution steps and system changes within internal ticketing and knowledge management systems. Maintain strong communication with internal teams and customers regarding issue status and resolution timelines. Requirements 8+ years of IT experience. MUST BE fluent in English. 3–6 years of experience supporting IT infrastructure in an MSP, enterprise IT, or hosting environment. Experience with Windows or Linux server administration. Experience with virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, etc.). Familiarity with storage, backup, and disaster recovery systems. Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. Experience working within ticketing systems and following structured support processes. Strong documentation and communication skills. Preferred Certifications such as VMware VCP, Microsoft, or cloud infrastructure certifications. Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment with exposure to ITIL-based service delivery models. Experience with enterprise infrastructure technologies including VMware vSphere, Cisco UCS, and Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD). Cloud platform administration experience;
Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Amazon Web Services (AWS) are preferred. Experience with cloud platforms, particularly Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including infrastructure design, administration, and troubleshooting. Administration experience with Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM), and enterprise storage platforms. Familiarity with identity platforms (Active Directory, Okta), firewalls (Palo Alto, Cisco FTD), and backup/disaster recovery solutions is a plus.

title: Analista Técnico em Modelagem Florestal e Geoespacial
description:
Descrição

Buscamos um(a) Analista de Modelagem Florestal e Geoespacial para apoiar a mensuração e monitoramento de carbono ALM, ARR e REDD+. O(A) profissional atuará em conjunto com o time de carbono para combinar dados de campo, inventários e sensoriamento remoto (satélite, LiDAR, drones) para gerar estimativas transparentes e auditáveis de biomassa e estoques de carbono.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Planejar e executar inventários florestais para mensuração de biomassa e estoques de carbono;  Desenvolver e validar modelos de crescimento, biomassa e carbono em diferentes compartimentos florestais;  Integrar dados de parcelas, imagens de satélite, drones e LiDAR em análises espaciais;  Elaborar curvas de crescimento, projeções de estoques de carbono e quantificação de emissões/remoções de GEE; Apoiar a elaboração de documentos técnicos exigidos por padrões internacionais (VCS, CCB);  Conduzir análises estatísticas de incerteza e preparar relatórios auditáveis para certificação de créditos de carbono; Garantir a rastreabilidade e reprodutibilidade das análises realizadas. 

Requisitos e qualificações

Formação em Engenharia Florestal, Ciências Biológicas, Geografia ou áreas correlatas;  Experiência comprovada em inventário florestal, biomassa e modelagem de carbono;  Conhecimento de geoprocessamento e sensoriamento remoto (QGIS/ArcGIS, Google Earth Engine);  Conhecimento de metodologias internacionais de reporte de carbono (IPCC, VCS, CCB).
